title: Mid-Term Ejections
summary:
Mid-Term Ejections
Whether one identifies with the Republicans or the Democrats, this week's turn of events in Washington, DC was certainly interesting. The 2006 Mid-Term Elections saw Democrats take the majority in both the Senate (51%) and the House of Representatives (54%) for the remainder of George W. The effects of the re- balance of power will undoubtedly be widespread.

children.title: Changing the Committees
children.summary: Perhaps the most drastic initial makeover will be in the House of Representatives committee leadership. A pervasive concern with the anticipated changes is the amount of oversight that is likely to occur, drawing out the legislative process.

children.title: Understanding Industry
children.summary: Issues concerning climate change, emissions and alternative fuel sources are also likely to be at the forefront of discussions. These issues are likely to be addressed by both Democrats and Republicans alike- perhaps finding common ground.
